ambiguities: putaway definition text in brief is garbled ("strikes>=..."); strikes==2 after-pitch reading matched. Note a PA can only reach strikes==2 after a pitch, so a 3rd-strike-only PA is impossible, but PAs ending by 2-strike foul-tip K etc. are all included.

p_ vs b_ naming: p_ = team pitching staff while fielding, b_ = hitters while batting; p_hard_hit/ev_mean/la_mean are contact ALLOWED, b_ contact produced; easy to misread. Also p_ whiff/csw are staff-strength (higher=better) while b_ are hitter-weakness.
EWMA is not reset at season boundaries (series runs across 2021-2024); resetting per season fails ~75% of rows. Early-season rows therefore use prior-season data.

csw denominator is all pitches (including ones with unknown class); fb/brk/off shares use known-class pitches only; swing_in/out exclude null zone; ev-based metrics only cover balls in play (non-null ev), so hard_hit is share of batted balls, not of pitches.
max_speed is a max, so EWMA of per-game maxima is sensitive to speed outliers/tracking errors.
Games with missing pitch data (NaN per-game values) are kept in the series and skipped, counting toward min_periods only if non-NaN.
Sample is only 40 team-games; empty-denominator edge cases (e.g. no swings) not exercised.
